description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the primary sexual characteristics over time, from their formation to the mature structures. The primary sexual characteristics are the testes in males and the ovaries in females and they develop in response to sex hormone secretion. [GOC:ai]
label: DEVELOPMENT OF PRIMARY SEXUAL CHARACTERISTICS *

description: The establishment of the sex of an organism by physical differentiation. [GOC:ai]
label: SEX DIFFERENTIATION *

description: The progression of the reproductive system over time from its formation to the mature structure. The reproductive system consists of the organs that function in reproduction. [GOC:dph]
label: REPRODUCTIVE SYSTEM DEVELOPMENT *

description: The establishment of the sex of a male organism by physical differentiation. [GOC:bf]
label: MALE SEX DIFFERENTIATION *

description: The process in which the anatomical structures of the eye are generated and organized. [GOC:jid, GOC:mtg_sensu]
label: EYE MORPHOGENESIS *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of substances. [GOC:go_curators]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF CATABOLIC PROCESS *

description: The assembly or remodeling of chromatin composed of DNA complexed with histones, other associated proteins, and sometimes RNA. [PMID:20404130]
label: CHROMATIN ORGANIZATION *

description: A cellular process involving delivery of a portion of the cytoplasm to lysosomes or to the plant or fungal vacuole that does not involve direct transport through the endocytic or vacuolar protein sorting (Vps) pathways. This process typically leads to degradation of the cargo; however, it can also be used to deliver resident proteins, such as in the cytoplasm-to-vacuole targeting (Cvt) pathway. [PMID:21997368, PMID:22966490, PMID:28596378]
label: PROCESS UTILIZING AUTOPHAGIC MECHANISM *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate, or extent of an immune system process. [GOC:add]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF IMMUNE SYSTEM PROCESS *

description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus from a bacterium. [GOC:hb]
label: RESPONSE TO BACTERIUM *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of locomotion of a cell or organism. [GOC:go_curators]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF LOCOMOTION *

description: An immune response mediated by cells expressing specific receptors for antigens produced through a somatic diversification process, and allowing for an enhanced secondary response to subsequent exposures to the same antigen (immunological memory). [GO_REF:0000022, GOC:add, ISBN:0781735149]
label: ADAPTIVE IMMUNE RESPONSE *

description: Any process of the immune system that executes a component of an immune response. An effector immune process takes place after its activation. [GO_REF:0000022, GOC:add, ISBN:0781735149]
label: IMMUNE EFFECTOR PROCESS *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate, or extent of an immune effector process. [GOC:add]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF IMMUNE EFFECTOR PROCESS *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of an immune effector process. [GOC:add]
label: REGULATION OF IMMUNE EFFECTOR PROCESS *

description: A vesicle-mediated transport process that results in the engulfment of external particulate material by phagocytes and their delivery to the lysosome. The particles are initially contained within phagocytic vacuoles (phagosomes), which then fuse with primary lysosomes to effect digestion of the particles. [ISBN:0198506732]
label: PHAGOCYTOSIS *
